truthBoundary: Current levels are evidence-bounded. Open source and passing CI do not inherit provider-bound or production proof.

scoreViews.name: Operational readiness
scoreViews.scope: Strict minimum of critical components in each release profile; computed by the readiness engine

components.name: Engineering codebase
blockers: provider release and continuous assurance receipts absent
components.nextGate: Bind exact release artifact to a provider semantic canary.

components.name: CI Airlock and authority gate
blockers: no provider-bound release gate
components.nextGate: Prove provider identity, deny paths and exact-head release admission.

components.name: Daily benchmark scheduler
blockers: workflow remains unmerged
no repeated scheduled-run evidence
components.nextGate: Admit the reviewed workflow and retain repeated immutable run receipts.

components.name: Official-source registry refresh
blockers: no repeated provider artifact history
components.nextGate: Run scheduled refreshes and prove review-only handling of changed sources.

components.name: Benchmark knowledge repository
blockers: complete restore and retention proof absent
components.nextGate: Prove versioned restore, access isolation and immutable receipt retention.

components.name: Canonical score contract
blockers: production SLO and rollback/restore proof absent
components.nextGate: Operate the separated score views through a controlled release with live SLO and restore proof.

components.name: Security Leak Guard
blockers: no production DLP or incident exercise
components.nextGate: Prove live release blocking, secret rotation and incident recovery.

components.name: Owner governance and authority
blockers: production approval and emergency-stop drills absent
components.nextGate: Exercise bounded approval, veto, emergency stop and recovery.

components.name: Gemini model adapter
blockers: provider authentication unresolved
components.nextGate: Pass two exact-model semantic canaries through least-privilege WIF.

components.name: Gemini provider semantic canary
blockers: latest provider canary failed before model invocation
components.nextGate: Repair identity binding and obtain two bounded semantic readbacks.

components.name: Google workload identity federation
blockers: token exchange returned invalid_target
live pool/provider/IAM state unverified
components.nextGate: Read back the live pool, provider, audience, subject mapping and service-account binding.

components.name: Cloud Run deployment package
blockers: no provider deployment proof
components.nextGate: Deploy a zero-traffic private revision with exact runtime identity.

components.name: Cloud Run live runtime
blockers: billing, APIs, IAM, service and revision state unverified
components.nextGate: Read provider state, then prove a zero-traffic private revision and rollback.

components.name: Secret Manager runtime binding
blockers: secret existence, IAM binding and runtime mount unverified
components.nextGate: Define owner and least-privilege secret lifecycle, then verify provider binding.

components.name: OpenAI provider binding
blockers: OpenAI Developers connector unavailable
local API key unset
components.nextGate: Define the optional provider role and establish an authorized bounded canary route.

components.name: Multi-model policy router
blockers: policy-equivalent live adapters not proven
components.nextGate: Run fixed-dataset equivalence, failover and no-dilution tests.

components.name: Observability and evaluation fabric
blockers: distributed traces, golden datasets and continuous evals absent
components.nextGate: Implement trace propagation and versioned offline evaluation datasets.

components.name: SRE, SLO and incident operations
blockers: service SLO, error budget, on-call and game-day proof absent
components.nextGate: Define measurable SLOs and execute rollback, restore and incident drills.

components.name: Cost, quota and capacity controls
blockers: billing, quota, budget and capacity state unverified
components.nextGate: Define zero-surprise budgets and read back live quota and billing guardrails.

components.name: Backup and deterministic restore
blockers: provider-backed full restore and RTO/RPO proof absent
components.nextGate: Run a provider-backed restore canary and measure RTO/RPO.

components.name: Google Drive canonical storage
blockers: complete recursive reconciliation and restore exercise absent
components.nextGate: Prove recursive manifest reconciliation, permissions and recovery.

components.name: Gmail evidence projection
components.nextGate: Maintain as a projection; Gmail is not canonical storage.

components.name: Canva design projection
blockers: no approved canonical system-design projection
components.nextGate: Publish an approved read-only architecture projection with readback.

components.name: Internal development team operating model
blockers: DORA baselines, ownership map and incident practice not operating continuously
components.nextGate: Assign service ownership and measure delivery, reliability and learning outcomes.
